ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, D and E are the midpoints of AB and AC, respectively. If $DE=4$, what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $D$ and $E$ are the midpoints of sides $AB$ and $AC$ respectively,\\
it follows that $DE$ is the midsegment of $\triangle ABC$.\\
Since $DE = 4$,\\
it follows that $BC = 2DE = 2 \times 4 = \boxed{8}$.
